text: Severity (S) (d) Severity is the value associated with the most serious effect for a given failure mode. Severity is a relative ranking within the scope of the individual FMEA. Suggested Evaluation Criteria The team should agree on evaluation criteria and a ranking system and apply them consistently, even if modified for individual process analysis. (See Table Crl below for criteria guidelines.) It is not recommended to modify criteria ranking values of 9 and 10. Failure modes with a rank of severity 1 should not be analyzed further.
